instruction_ref: CEO 2026-11-16: 新規が止まる原因を解消する / 直せ; production control fault post-publish Task bridge 30-second timeout
instruction: Restore Sellemy scheduling without bypassing quality or CEO gates. The canonical OS task_append process took ~35 seconds, exceeding the 30-second bridge timeout and recording feedback_task_bridge_failed as a publication pause. Allow a bounded 90s Task bridge operation. When controller has a recorded recoverable quality-control infrastructure fault and no CEO quality alert, retry delivery to the same canonical Task/Event ID, independently rerun post-publish QA against the exact deployed article, and record a deterministic auditable recovery feedback only if Task/Event acknowledgement and green content and novelty QA are verified. Recovery entries must not inflate the publication frequency target. Red/failed QA or Task bridge must keep publication paused.
preserved_rules: Never clear a CEO quality alert automatically
Never restart publication when actual post-publish QA is red or Task/Event bridge cannot acknowledge
Task/Event message identity remains deterministic and idempotent
No modification to historical feedback log or CEO review approval artifacts
No extra published/CEO-reviewed article counted for quality-control recovery
No cross-BU source or OS canonical schema changes
3 discovery angles x 2 products and all independent QA kept
